claim: Patchline ships a long-horizon cohort study tracking adopters for twelve months with attrition analysis. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the attrition claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make long-horizon-cohort-study-gate`.
